cohort: The study included all newborns with hypothyroidism who were delivered through LSCS in a Government Medical College Sindhudurg.
finding: The incidence of congenital hypothyroidism (high TSH) in newborns delivered through LSCS was 8.70%, and there was a statistically significant association between clinical outcomes and neonatal status.
mod_finding: N/A (The study focused solely on newborns delivered through LSCS and did not compare different modes of birth for the outcome.)
followup_time: N/A (Outcomes appear to be measured in the immediate neonatal period, with no explicit long-term follow-up mentioned.)
cross-section timing: N/A (This is a prospective study, not a cross-sectional one, though initial outcomes are measured in newborns.)
birth_weight: The majority (66.21%) of newborns had a birth weight between 2 to 2.5 kg.
